tiles.kind_rule: none: two ui_chara rows share this tile
tiles.name: Pyra/Mythra

tiles.kind_rule: none: fighter_kind is not in the main kind table
tiles.name: Random

rules: tile order: ui_chara_db rows with disp_order >= 0 sorted by (disp_order, row), excluding the combined Mii row (is_mii=1, fighter_kind=0)
rows sharing a disp_order share one tile: first row = typed word, second row = alternate word
application kind = index of the ui_chara fighter_kind hash in the main kind table; ice_climber plays fighter_kind_popo; composite tiles and Random have none
caption = English msg_name nam_chr1_00_<name_id> (else nam_chr0_00_<name_id>), trailing space trimmed
rect = slot centre +- half the slot pitch; the partial last row is centred on the 13-column grid
